title: Projects
name: Project name
nameTooLong: The name is longer than {{max}} characters
nameDuplicate: A project with this name already exists
nameReadOnly: The project is read only — renaming is unavailable
importHint: Import opens in the next tab: choose an AT5 or GEDCOM file and preview it before loading.
restoreHint: A new project will be created from the selected backup. The current project is not changed.
restoreEmptyHint: Create a backup from the project card.
exportHint: Creates a ZIP archive with one data file and a media folder.
exportAt5Hint: AT5 exchange database for re-import into Gentree, plus a sibling .files folder.
exportGedcomHint: GEDCOM 5.5.1 file and a sibling .files folder with media.
exportGedcom70Hint: GEDCOM 7.0.1 file with UTF-8, media, sources and citations, plus a sibling .files folder.
revealBackupHint: Open the backup folder in the file manager and select the file
lastBackupHint: The backup date is a local app label, not project data.
confirmDelete: Delete project "{{name}}"? Its folder will be moved to trash.
deleteHint: Files are not deleted permanently: the folder can be restored from the trash manually.
deleteOpenHint: An open project cannot be deleted — close it first.
busyHint: Wait for the current operation to finish.
emptyHint: Create a new project or import data from a file.
emptyCreateHint: Add the first person, branches and links manually
confirmBulkDelete: Delete the selected projects ({{count}})? Their folders will be moved to trash.

merge.title: Merge projects
merge.hint: The source projects stay unchanged. Review every suggestion: the new project is created only after you confirm.
merge.name: Name of the new project
merge.nameRequired: Enter a name for the new project
merge.needTwoProjects: At least two projects are required to merge.
merge.emptyMatchesHint: People from the right project will be added as new.
merge.unmatchedRightHint: These people have no suggested pair in the left project.
merge.noPairedEvents: No paired events: each person keeps their own events.
merge.keepBothHint: Both people stay in the project with their own events.

warnings.GENDER_CONFLICT: Gender conflict: the suggestion was rejected
warnings.DATE_CONFLICT: Date conflict: the suggestion was rejected
warnings.UNMATCHED_RIGHT_PERSON: A person without a pair was copied as new
warnings.RELATIONSHIP_CONFLICT: Conflicting relationship type: the existing edge was kept
warnings.RELATIONSHIP_COLLAPSED: A relationship would have become a self-link and was dropped
warnings.CITATION_TARGET_DROPPED: A citation pointed at a removed row and was skipped
warnings.REFERENCE_DROPPED: A reference to a missing row was dropped
warnings.MEDIA_MISSING: A media file is missing: the row was skipped
warnings.MEDIA_CHANGED: A media file changed on disk: the stored copy was kept
